stories.title: 'Politicians know rising gas prices can cost them votes'
stories.summary: The increase in fuel prices generates public anger and poses a dilemma for authorities, who must decide whether to implement support measures. Economic choices, Le Monde columnist Isabelle Chaperon notes, often hinge on upcoming elections.

stories.title: Ladin: Dolomites villages refuse to give up on ancient language
stories.summary: Year after year, the mountains of the Dolomites become more popular with tourists. Amid millions of visitors, 30,000 inhabitants speak a language only they understand: Ladin, one of the oldest minority languages in Europe.
